title: After the Kikuka Sho: The Next Challenge Awaits

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I couldn't pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Next time, I guess. Yeah, next time. Next time, I'll definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking through the runners' tunnel to pick up Matikanetannhauser when I hear some faint voices.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …I just want to say thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I really, truly gave it my all today! I competed as the best version of myself!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And I think—no, I know it's thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So… thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I feel the same.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'm several times better than I was previously. But that's only because I needed to be if I wished to stay ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to running with you senior year too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Me too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After exchanging compliments, the two of them return to the waiting room in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ughhh… I was so sure I had it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But the good news is that I know what I still need to work on, and I realized that I really can compete in big, long-distance races like this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: On that note… I have something I'd like to suggest…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking about what I wanna do after the Classic Triple Crown tour is finished.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Do you remember what the director said to me at summer camp?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Like how it's not my race record that's interesting, and that being ordinary is part of my charm or something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I was so happy when she said that but, honestly, there's something I just can't wrap my head around.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: After all, the people who motivate others are usually really cool and strong and… all sparkly-like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I want to live up to the expectations she has for me, but the more I think about, the more confused I get.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So, for now, I'm just gonna go where my heart tells me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And right now, the spring Tenno Sho is what gets my heart thumping most!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I know it won't be easy! It's a 3,200-meter long-distance G1 race that decides the best stayer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm sure coming up with a strategy will be tough, and I probably don't have enough stamina yet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But still, wouldn't it be awesome to win a big race like that in the spring?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may not be aware of it herself, but her unwavering optimism is one of her strongest traits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And I know we don't have to run a qualifier before it, but I'd still like to run another long-distance race before then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Like the 3,400-meter Diamond Stakes or something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's really no reason for me to decline. If she wants to do it, I want to help.
choice_data_list: Okay. Let's make your next race the Diamond Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The next race is mine to win. I've just gotta work harder and grind my way to the top!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a race! Bourbon was great, of course, but so was Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser? I know her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: People have been talking about her since the Japanese Derby! She's really optimistic and you can't help but like her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: She's not overwhelmingly talented or anything, but she's a good runner who works hard and never gives up.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: She works hard and never gives up… You're right about that.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: Um, e-excuse me! Would you mind sharing those thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: Especially in regards to Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, sure thing! Gotta spread the good word about Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Everyone in the know has their eye on her. She's a racer's racer. Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Anyhoo, it's about time I get back to campus for some running! I need to catch up too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may not have won, but she definitely showed off what she's capable of at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Up next is the even longer Diamond Stakes!
